summary: std/json: the error path of a number out of Float's range deep in a document is joined once
details: the error path of a number out of Float's range deep in a document is joined once; it was built a level at a time, copying the path below at every level (quadratic for deep long keys: a 10 MB text copied about 50 GB). Found by the decision 0616 json review's second reader.
